title: Dashboard 'today' under the shipped production config
measures: Implements today's dashboard numbers so they hold under the configuration the app ships with (config/production.json, loaded by src/main.js: the shop's day is Australia/Sydney), not only under the default UTC config the visible tests load; the natural UTC-midnight 'today' also counts orders from the previous Sydney day.
prompt: The dashboard header needs today's numbers. Add todaySoFar(store, now) in src/dashboard/today.js returning { orders, revenueCents } for the orders placed today so far, not counting cancelled ones.

commits.message: feat(shop): config per environment, orders, daily sales report
